title: QA Automation Tester (Selenium/Playwright)
description: Company Description Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years. Job Description Role: QA Test Engineer Location: Bengaluru, India Department: Eurofins IT Solutions – BioPharma Product Testing (BPT) Experience: 2-5+ Years About the Role We are looking for a highly skilled QA Test Engineer to join the eLIMS-BPT team. The candidate will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, compliance, and performance of our Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) and related applications used by global BioPharma laboratories. The role requires strong expertise in functional testing, test automation, release validation, root cause analysis, and collaboration with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment. Key Responsibilities Quality Assurance & Testing Analyze requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to identify test scenarios. Create, maintain, and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test data. Perform Functional, Integration, Regression, Smoke, and UAT support testing. Validate complex business workflows across eLIMS-BPT and integrated applications. Ensure complete test coverage and traceability between requirements and test evidence. Test Automation Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks and automated test suites. Improve automation coverage to reduce manual testing effort and increase release confidence. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. Analyze automation failures and continuously improve test reliability. Defect Management Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects through closure. Perform detailed root cause analysis for escaped defects. Work closely with developers and business stakeholders to validate fixes. Release & Validation Support Support release planning, validation activities, and controlled deployments. Participate in release readiness reviews and risk assessments. Ensure required evidence is generated and maintained for regulated environments. Support audit and compliance activities when required. Collaboration & Leadership Collaborate with Product Owners, Developers, Business Analysts, Functional Analysts, and Support teams. Mentor junior QA engineers and guide testing best practices. Participate actively in grooming, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Drive process improvements to improve product quality and team efficiency. Quality Engineering Define and track quality metrics such as defect leakage, automation coverage, and test effectiveness. Recommend improvements in testing strategies, tools, and processes. Promote a quality-first mindset across delivery teams. Required Skills & Experience Technical Skills 2-5+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance. Strong experience in Functional and Regression Testing. Experience with Test Automation tools such as WebDriverIO, Selenium, Playwright, or equivalent. Good understanding of API testing using Postman or similar tools. Experience with SQL and database validation. Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies. Experience using Azure DevOps or similar ALM tools. Understanding of CI/CD concepts and release management practices. Domain Knowledge Experience in Healthcare, Life Sciences, Laboratory Systems, LIMS, ELN, or regulated environments is preferred. Understanding of validation concepts and evidence generation in regulated systems is an advantage. Familiarity with GxP, GMP, GLP, CSV, or related compliance processes is desirable. Soft Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work independently and take ownership. Mentoring and leadership capabilities. Strong attention to detail and quality mindset. Nice to Have Experience with Performance Testing. Experience with Azure services and cloud-based applications. Experience working on enterprise-scale distributed systems. Knowledge of security testing concepts. Key Success Measures Low defect leakage to production. Improved automation coverage. High-quality release validation. Effective collaboration across teams. Timely delivery of testing activities. Continuous improvement initiatives contributing to overall product quality. Qualifications MCA or Bachelors in Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent. Additional Information Personal Skills: Customer-service oriented with a problem-solving attitude; Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential; Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change; Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing); Structured and clear writing skills; Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning; Demonstrated positive attitude, self-motivated, team player. PERFORMANCE APPRAISAL CRITERIA : Eurofins has a strong focus on Performance Management system. This includes quarterly calibrations, half-yearly reviews and annual reviews. The KPIs shall be set and may vary slightly between projects. These will be clearly communicated, documented during the first 30 days of your joining.

description: Senior QA Engineer Specialist Esko | Veralto Corporation Location: Bangalore, India | On-site Reports To: Senior Team Leader About the Role The Opportunity We’re seeking a self-driven Senior QA Specialist to strengthen quality engineering for WebCenter Enterprise, a Java/J2EE web application. In this hands-on role, you’ll independently own quality for assigned features and product areas, combining thoughtful manual testing with the creation and maintenance of reliable automated test scripts. You’ll work with the current SAHI-based automation suite and help evolve the framework, including evaluating Playwright or Selenium where appropriate. You’ll work closely with software engineers, product managers, and the Senior Team Leader to translate product and technical risks into an effective test approach. You’ll execute tests, interpret results, distinguish product defects from automation or environment failures, and communicate evidence-based quality risks. Success means meaningful automation coverage, effective exploratory testing, earlier defect detection, and dependable test results for WebCenter Enterprise. What You'll Do In this role, you will: Independently own the test approach for assigned features and product areas: assess customer and technical risk, clarify acceptance criteria, estimate effort, prioritize coverage, and raise dependencies or quality concerns early. Design and execute a balanced set of manual and automated tests, including exploratory, functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end testing; select the test layer and technique that best addresses the risk. Create, maintain, and improve reliable SAHI-based automated test scripts using established design patterns and reusable code; contribute to framework design and evaluate Playwright or Selenium where appropriate. Interpret test and CI/CD results, investigate failures systematically, and distinguish product defects from automation, test-data, or environment issues using logs, browser developer tools, and reproducible evidence. Reduce flaky tests through root-cause analysis; maintain representative test data, repeatable setup and cleanup, dependable environments, and clear, actionable failure reporting. Collaborate with developers and product managers throughout the development lifecycle to improve testability, find defects earlier, and align testing with delivery timelines and product quality goals. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and improve QA processes, tooling, and feedback loops while protecting the stability of existing coverage. Produce concise, accurate test cases, automation code, defect reports, traceability, and quality summaries; communicate coverage, evidence, blockers, and release risks clearly to stakeholders. Share domain knowledge and practical QA and automation techniques with colleagues, and use approved AI tools responsibly where useful while independently validating outputs and protecting proprietary and customer data. What We're Looking For Minimum Qualifications These are the must-have requirements for the role: 8+ years of professional experience in software quality assurance, test automation, software development, or a combination thereof, including ownership of quality for complex web-product features. Strong hands-on ability in automated and manual testing, including writing, debugging, reviewing, and maintaining reusable automation code with established design patterns; practical programming or scripting skills in JavaScript, Java, or a comparable language; proficiency with Git, code review, and maintainable coding practices; and sound judgment in applying exploratory, functional, regression, and automated testing. Hands-on experience creating and maintaining web test automation with SAHI, Selenium, Playwright, or a comparable framework, together with the ability to become productive in SAHI. SAHI is the current automation tool; prior expertise in SAHI is not required. Hands-on experience designing, organizing, and implementing automated unit, integration, and API tests with Java frameworks such as TestNG, JUnit, or equivalent solutions, including parameterized or data-driven testing; API coverage should include HTTP/REST, authentication, response and schema validation, and negative scenarios using RestAssured or comparable code-based tools, with Postman or similar tools for exploratory testing. Experience integrating, maintaining, and diagnosing automated test execution in CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps, including analysis of failures and reliable reporting of results. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, including interpreting test results and investigating failures with logs, browser developer tools, and reproducible evidence. Experience testing web and client/server products, preferably Java/J2EE enterprise applications, with a good understanding of browser behavior, sessions, authentication, authorization, and integrations. Strong risk-based test-design skills, including equivalence partitioning, boundary-value analysis, and state-transition testing. Ability to design representative test data, maintain repeatable setup and cleanup, and validate results and data integrity, including practical use of basic SQL queries where appropriate. Experience working in Agile or Scrum teams and contributing quality engineering and automation activities throughout iterative, sprint-based delivery. Clear, proactive communication and a collaborative working style, with the ability to explain quality risks, ask relevant questions, build consensus, and support less-experienced colleagues. Preferred Qualifications The following qualifications will help distinguish stronger candidates; relevant experience in one or more of these areas is valued: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field. Relevant professional testing certification, such as ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL); advanced or specialist credentials—particularly ISTQB Advanced Level Test Automation Engineering (CTAL-TAE), Technical Test Analyst (CTAL-TTA), Quality in DevOps (CT-QDO), or an equivalent recognized certification are a differentiator for this senior automation-focused role. Practical experience using approved AI tools to accelerate test design, automation-code development, test-data generation, or failure analysis, with independent review and validation of outputs and appropriate protection of proprietary and customer data. Direct experience maintaining or evolving SAHI-based automation suites. Familiarity with Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) practices and experience using Cucumber to translate expected user behaviors and acceptance criteria into clear, executable test scenarios and maintainable automated test scripts. Experience with performance testing and tools such as JMeter. Experience testing AI-assisted features with non-deterministic outputs, including correctness, consistency, reliability, and safe fallback behavior. Working knowledge of Jira and Atlassian Wiki, or comparable platforms, for defect management, test documentation, and collaboration. description: Senior QA Engineer Specialist Esko | Veralto Corporation Location: Bangalore, India | On-site Reports To: Senior Team Leader About the Role The Opportunity We’re seeking a self-driven Senior QA Specialist to strengthen quality engineering for WebCenter Enterprise, a Java/J2EE web application. In this hands-on role, you’ll independently own quality for assigned features and product areas, combining thoughtful manual testing with the creation and maintenance of reliable automated test scripts. You’ll work with the current SAHI-based automation suite and help evolve the framework, including evaluating Playwright or Selenium where appropriate. You’ll work closely with software engineers, product managers, and the Senior Team Leader to translate product and technical risks into an effective test approach. You’ll execute tests, interpret results, distinguish product defects from automation or environment failures, and communicate evidence-based quality risks. Success means meaningful automation coverage, effective exploratory testing, earlier defect detection, and dependable test results for WebCenter Enterprise. What You'll Do In this role, you will: Independently own the test approach for assigned features and product areas: assess customer and technical risk, clarify acceptance criteria, estimate effort, prioritize coverage, and raise dependencies or quality concerns early. Design and execute a balanced set of manual and automated tests, including exploratory, functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end testing; select the test layer and technique that best addresses the risk. Create, maintain, and improve reliable SAHI-based automated test scripts using established design patterns and reusable code; contribute to framework design and evaluate Playwright or Selenium where appropriate. Interpret test and CI/CD results, investigate failures systematically, and distinguish product defects from automation, test-data, or environment issues using logs, browser developer tools, and reproducible evidence. Reduce flaky tests through root-cause analysis; maintain representative test data, repeatable setup and cleanup, dependable environments, and clear, actionable failure reporting. Collaborate with developers and product managers throughout the development lifecycle to improve testability, find defects earlier, and align testing with delivery timelines and product quality goals. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and improve QA processes, tooling, and feedback loops while protecting the stability of existing coverage. Produce concise, accurate test cases, automation code, defect reports, traceability, and quality summaries; communicate coverage, evidence, blockers, and release risks clearly to stakeholders. Share domain knowledge and practical QA and automation techniques with colleagues, and use approved AI tools responsibly where useful while independently validating outputs and protecting proprietary and customer data. Strong hands-on ability in automated and manual testing, including writing, debugging, reviewing, and maintaining reusable automation code with established design patterns; practical programming or scripting skills in JavaScript, Java, or a comparable language; proficiency with Git, code review, and maintainable coding practices; and sound judgment in applying exploratory, functional, regression, and automated testing. Hands-on experience creating and maintaining web test automation with SAHI, Selenium, Playwright, or a comparable framework, together with the ability to become productive in SAHI. SAHI is the current automation tool; prior expertise in SAHI is not required. Hands-on experience designing, organizing, and implementing automated unit, integration, and API tests with Java frameworks such as TestNG, JUnit, or equivalent solutions, including parameterized or data-driven testing; API coverage should include HTTP/REST, authentication, response and schema validation, and negative scenarios using RestAssured or comparable code-based tools, with Postman or similar tools for exploratory testing. Experience integrating, maintaining, and diagnosing automated test execution in CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps, including analysis of failures and reliable reporting of results. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, including interpreting test results and investigating failures with logs, browser developer tools, and reproducible evidence. Experience testing web and client/server products, preferably Java/J2EE enterprise applications, with a good understanding of browser behavior, sessions, authentication, authorization, and integrations. Strong risk-based test-design skills, including equivalence partitioning, boundary-value analysis, and state-transition testing. Ability to design representative test data, maintain repeatable setup and cleanup, and validate results and data integrity, including practical use of basic SQL queries where appropriate. Experience working in Agile or Scrum teams and contributing quality engineering and automation activities throughout iterative, sprint-based delivery. Clear, proactive communication and a collaborative working style, with the ability to explain quality risks, ask relevant questions, build consensus, and support less-experienced colleagues. Preferred Qualifications The following qualifications will help distinguish stronger candidates; relevant experience in one or more of these areas is valued: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field. Relevant professional testing certification, such as ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL); advanced or specialist credentials—particularly ISTQB Advanced Level Test Automation Engineering (CTAL-TAE), Technical Test Analyst (CTAL-TTA), Quality in DevOps (CT-QDO), or an equivalent recognized certification are a differentiator for this senior automation-focused role. Practical experience using approved AI tools to accelerate test design, automation-code development, test-data generation, or failure analysis, with independent review and validation of outputs and appropriate protection of proprietary and customer data. Direct experience maintaining or evolving SAHI-based automation suites. Familiarity with Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) practices and experience using Cucumber to translate expected user behaviors and acceptance criteria into clear, executable test scenarios and maintainable automated test scripts. Experience with performance testing and tools such as JMeter. Experience testing AI-assisted features with non-deterministic outputs, including correctness, consistency, reliability, and safe fallback behavior. Working knowledge of Jira and Atlassian Wiki, or comparable platforms, for defect management, test documentation, and collaboration.
